review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review against the pinned J3/24-007 PDF: doc/source_audits/batch_124.json. The reviewer re-read the original sections (PDF p236-241), re-derived unit hashes rather than accepting the author receipt, independently verified the three-way section boundary on page 236, and independently confirmed the named-STAT-value list is exhaustive. Three blocking findings were closed by correction commit 09faa38 and re-verified by the same reviewer: C1177SR-001 (twenty non-numbered shall-not-depend requirements were framed as diagnostics although no processor is required to reject them and dependency is not statically decidable), C1177SR-002 (the ACQUIRED_LOCK= true result on an initially unlocked local lock was over-suppressed as unobservable when a single-image program can observe it), and C1177SR-003 (11.7.11 p5 and p10 compound effects were collapsed into STAT-only facets). Source accounting only: no fixture was bound, authored_facets is unchanged at 1839. ERRMSG text is unspecified by the standard, so no text, inequality, sentinel or substring oracle is permitted anywhere in this packet.
